generic-person-as-agent: The deceased saint is the patient of canonization. Literate states a capacity.

generic-person-as-alive: The canonized saint definition explicitly describes a person who has died.
generic-person-as-body: The approved BODY scope requires bodily content in the definition itself.
generic-person-as-stative: The approved BE scope requires stative content in the definition itself.
generic-person-as-thing: NSM keeps SOMEONE and SOMETHING as separate arguments. WordNet root overlap is source-specific.
The curated pronoun someone has SOMETHING open.
